sentences.text: Frank van Zanten, 59, has led Bunzl as chief executive since 2016, having joined the group through his family business, which Bunzl acquired in the mid-1990s, and having served as managing director of Continental Europe from 2005.

sentences.quote: Founders and owner-managers typically remain in leadership roles within their operating companies, and the most successful among them progress to regional and group-level senior roles over time.
sentences.text: His career path reflects the decentralised model he now oversees, in which founders and owner-managers of acquired businesses stay in leadership roles and the most successful progress to regional and group-level positions, making Bunzl an attractive home for sellers.

sentences.text: Under his stewardship, capital allocation balances reinvestment in IT systems, warehouses and vehicle routing with acquisitions and shareholder returns, including a dividend grown for 33 consecutive years at a 9% compound annual rate.
